name: The Meaning Of Life
overview: Scripture reveals that the true meaning of life is not found in material wealth or possessions, as Jesus warns against covetousness in Luke 12:15. Instead, eternal life and fulfillment come through faith in Jesus Christ, who declares Himself to be the bread of life, the light of the world, and the way to the Father (John 6:35; 8:12; 14:6). God's love is demonstrated in the giving of His only Son so that believers may receive everlasting life (John 3:16), highlighting that life’s ultimate purpose is found in a relationship with Christ.
